b5109a.surface: Application source repository / route and model mapping
b5109a.evidence: No source checkout or package manifests are present under /workspace; semgrep, secrets, trivy, and AST passes could only scan captured frontend HTML, so route handlers, auth guards, and data models remain unverified.

304a4d.evidence: Dynamic validation confirmed Nuxt dev build and unauthenticated transformed source/Vite assets; vuln-0002 filed with HTTP evidence and remediation.

history.evidence: Observed Nuxt `buildId:'dev'` and absolute local source paths in module URLs, but impact and whether dev assets expose source maps or privileged code require deeper dynamic validation.

954327.evidence: Authenticated cross-origin read was demonstrated on /admin/venues with reflected Origin and credentials; vuln-0001 filed.

history.evidence: Preflight reflected arbitrary Origin `http://evil.test` with `access-control-allow-credentials:true`; exploitability depends on authenticated cookie/API response behavior and state-changing endpoint validation, not tested in this architecture pass.

a8538d.surface: Nuxt frontend :3002 routes, static assets, Vite source paths
a8538d.risk_area: information disclosure / source maps / route mapping
a8538d.evidence: Nuxt dev server exposes absolute filesystem paths in HTML and serves transformed source files under `/_nuxt/Users/.../apps/web/`; `@vite/client`, page modules, stores and composables are retrievable unauthenticated. Parent should file source disclosure finding with PoC.

ed32cd.surface: Fastify API route registration and public endpoints
ed32cd.evidence: Reviewed runtime route registration and source for all public, auth, staff, admin, and floor-plan routes; no exploit attempted in recon phase.

dd34ae.evidence: Confirmed seeded accounts authenticate with password `password`; cookie observed HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 604800. No deep brute-force or bypass testing performed in mapping task.

e18cba.evidence: Static source review mapped requireAuth/requireVenueAccess/requireAdmin usage per route; no exploit validation performed. Parent agents should test IDOR and role boundaries.

348a55.surface: Nuxt frontend :3002 dev assets and source endpoints
348a55.risk_area: Unauthenticated source disclosure / exposed development server
348a55.evidence: Unauthenticated GET / returns Nuxt dev HTML with absolute local paths and /_nuxt/@vite/client; direct GET /_nuxt/composables/useApi.ts and /_nuxt/stores/auth.ts return application source (HTTP 200). Filed report with exchanges 186, 433, 403, and 526.

55175d.risk_area: Reflected CORS with credentials / cross-origin data disclosure
55175d.evidence: Origin http://evil.example is reflected with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true on preflight and authenticated GET; with a valid session cookie, /admin/venues returned venue data readable cross-origin (request 218), while unauthenticated baseline returned 401 (219). Reporting child spawned.

0c9a62.risk_area: route exposure and unauthenticated staff/admin access
0c9a62.evidence: Direct unauthenticated and role-based API tests completed: staff/admin routes require auth; host and venueadmin privilege boundaries returned 403; no frontend-only bypass reached protected data.

history.evidence: Routes return SSR HTML or dev 500; client middleware is only a browser redirect. API authorization was not dynamically tested in this recon slice; parent/API specialists must validate direct `/api` access and role checks.

1e0116.evidence: Authenticated request 218 from Origin http://evil.example returned 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflecting the attacker origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; unauthenticated baseline 219 returned 401 and preflight 524 succeeded.

1bc4a0.evidence: Created reservations with injected status, role, isAdmin, ownerId, userId, venueId, id, and nested-like extras; response persisted only pending state and server-selected venue/seating. Party size bounds, opening hours, lead time, and capacity were enforced.

409a65.risk_area: Login brute force, username enumeration, authentication errors
409a65.evidence: Invalid and valid usernames with wrong passwords returned identical 401 ERR_UNAUTHORIZED responses; five rapid attempts were all processed without lockout, but no account compromise or differentiated error was demonstrated.

36f1eb.evidence: Valid code returned only booking summary; random, altered, lowercase, and near-miss codes returned 404. Codes are 8-character high-entropy alphanumeric values; no unauthorized record was obtained.

ba6575.surface: gioi_session cookie on POST /staff/login and logout
ba6575.risk_area: Session cookie flags and logout invalidation
ba6575.evidence: Login sets HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800; replayed session authenticated /staff/me and logout invalidated it. Logout clears cookie and server-side session.

ee7cdb.evidence: Cancellation requires a valid booking code; random and modified codes returned 404. Valid-code cancellation transitions pending to cancelled and repeated invalid variants did not affect other reservations.

902317.risk_area: SQL injection / NoSQL / template or command injection
902317.evidence: Sprayed quote, boolean, stacked/time-delay, template, and prototype-pollution payloads; sqlmap against availability found no injectable parameter. Strict date/time/party validation blocks malformed values, and reservation strings are stored without execution.

5f7a2c.evidence: Login payloads with SQL tautologies and JSON operator objects returned 401 or schema 400; no authentication bypass observed.

5d371c.evidence: Feedback endpoint rejected valid-code reservations while pending and after cancellation with ERR_NOT_COMPLETED; arbitrary ratings and fields did not bypass completion requirement. No completed reservation fixture was available for end-to-end feedback persistence.

e643f9.surface: Fastify malformed requests and unknown routes
e643f9.evidence: Malformed JSON/schema failures expose only generic validation messages; unknown routes return structured 404 without stack traces, filesystem paths, or SQL details.

678a19.evidence: Proxy forwarded malformed date to API and returned generic 500 without reflection or execution; direct API sqlmap tests were negative.

a65808.surface: Public reservation and venue routes (URL/XML processing)
a65808.evidence: Mapped public API accepts reservation fields and venue/date parameters only; extra URL/callback fields are ignored, and no XML parser, fetch/import, webhook, or remote-resource processing endpoint was exposed in the mapped surface.

d548b6.surface: Nuxt development assets and source maps under /_nuxt
d548b6.risk_area: Source-map and development artifact information disclosure
d548b6.evidence: Source disclosure was dynamically confirmed across page modules, maps, Vite client, and API source; vuln-0002 covers this exposure.

history.evidence: Unauthenticated access to `/_nuxt/pages/login.vue` and `.map`, `@vite/client`, `builds/meta/dev.json`, and absolute local source paths is confirmed; no secret was found in login map, but full bundle/source review for credentials and privileged logic remains incomplete.

018bba.evidence: Injected `<svg onload=alert(1)>` as public guestName and examined compiled Nuxt render paths: guestName and guestNotes are emitted via Vue `_toDisplayString` text interpolation (HTML-escaped) across host/admin/guest pages; no v-html/innerHTML sink found.

1bfd26.surface: PUT /admin/venues/:id/floor-plan/image SVG upload and floor-plan rendering
1bfd26.evidence: Admin endpoint accepts SVG data URI, but returned content is used as image data in the floor-plan UI; SVG script/event payload is inert in an `` browsing context, and no HTML/innerHTML sink was identified in compiled Nuxt code. Raw SVG acceptance remains a hardening concern but no executable XSS impact was demonstrated.

0eae5f.evidence: Authenticated admin tested quote/boolean/stacked/time payloads in q/search/venueId. q/search are ignored or safely return data; venueId malformed values produce generic 500/UUID validation behavior, valid UUIDs return scoped results, and no timing or tautology oracle was observed.

3400cb.evidence: GET /staff/me, /staff/day, /staff/guests, /admin/venues and /admin/users return 401 without a session; valid POST /staff/reservations also returns 401 after schema validation.

ca9d82.surface: Role escalation: host/venueadmin against /admin and floor-plan/image actions
ca9d82.evidence: Host and venueadmin receive 403 super admin required for POST /admin/venues and PUT /admin/venues/{bali}/floor-plan/image; /admin/users is not accessible after valid schema.

0772db.surface: Cross-venue IDOR on staff guest/reservation object IDs
0772db.evidence: Host and venueadmin requests for Ubud guest and reservation IDs return 403 venue not accessible; same-venue records are available as intended. Admin can access cross-venue records by super-admin role.

a5a6e1.evidence: Unauthenticated public reservation accepted guestName =HYPERLINK(...); authenticated admin export returned the value unchanged as a formula-leading CSV field (booking GIOI-V93TGH7M). Filed as vuln-0003.

9ae461.evidence: Unauthenticated public reservation accepted guestName beginning `=HYPERLINK(...)`; authenticated admin CSV export returned the formula-leading value without a protective apostrophe/tab prefix. Filed as vuln-0003.
